_Notes: Land claims in adventure worlds. Prices are in Coins. The first hexagon is always free; the second costs ExtraCoins, and each one after that StepCoins more than the one before.
Prices, when given, overrides that: the price of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th ... hexagon, and past the end of the list the last price plus StepCoins each time.
BufferRings: how many rings of hexagons around someone else's land nobody else may claim. 0 lets claims touch.
RefundShare: the part of a hexagon's price given back when it is given up (0.5 is half).
Worlds: the adventure worlds with land claims. Empty means every adventure world.
Changing CellWidth or BodyDepth after people have claimed land hides their claims, so pick the size before opening.
